title: qq bot template preview response: the rendered sample and what did not resolve

source.description: Which configuration actually produced text: saved means the stored settings, so the text is exactly what a push would send right now.

text.description: Rendered message exactly as a push would send it.

truncated.description: True when the rendered text was cut at the effective maxMessageChars.

characters.description: Length of text counted in code points, the same unit as Array.from(text).length in the browser.

unknownVariables.description: Placeholders left untouched because the template named no known variable.

sampleUsed.description: True when at least one field of the request's sample object replaced the built-in sample value.

savedSnapshot.description: Present only when source is saved: the stored settings this render actually used, read from the plugin's own configuration rather than from the request. The settings component uses it as the baseline after a save it cannot observe otherwise.

excerpt_limit.description: Stored excerpt limit (setting excerpt_limit); 0 hides the excerpt.
